rules.label: back_arch
rules.rest_note: Your lower back arched on {n} reps. Ribs stacked over the hips keep the load off your lower back.

rules.label: incomplete_lockout
rules.rest_note: Next set, try reaching until your arms are nearly straight overhead.

rules.label: wrists_off_stack
rules.rest_note: Your wrists drifted out from over your elbows on {n} reps. Stacking them makes the press steadier.

rules.label: fast_lowering
rules.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. Around 2 s gives you more control.

knee.extra_note: The shoulder press puts little load on the knees. A seated press takes them out of it entirely.

tempo.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. A slower 2 to 3 s is gentler on a recovering shoulder.

shoulder.extra_note: The overhead range here is set shorter to suit a recovering shoulder. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.

back_arch.rest_note: Your lower back arched on {n} reps. A seated press with back support takes the strain off a recovering lower back.

lower_back.extra_note: The back arch limit here is set tighter to go easy on a recovering lower back. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.
